selected_policy.summary: Project-Lead-first scheduling with a fail-closed, versioned assignment-Runner adapter pinned to both repositories.
selected_policy.justification: This preserves REQ-0045-04 and REQ-0045-05 authority separation, uses the implemented agent-inbox Runner lifecycle without inventing an autodocs registry, and makes selector or documentation drift explicit fail-closed work for 0045-02.

conflicting_documentation.required_disposition: 0045-02 must reconcile the Runner documentation with the executable contract before adapter activation.

logical_recipe_binding.registry_status: logical names only; no executable registry is created or inferred
logical_recipe_binding.project_lead_gate: Supervisor performs minimum route-safety validation, then opens a priority-gated Project Lead offer before trusted ingestion or recipe execution.
logical_recipe_binding.runner_boundary: Runner validates and executes only the awarded typed transition; it does not select work, decide similarity or product disposition, accept proposals, grant authority, integrate, publish, or authorize release.

fail_closed_conditions: autodocs repository or authoritative-selector commit/blob/digest mismatch
agent-inbox repository or Runner-contract commit/blob/projection/digest mismatch
stale, absent, or mismatched Project Lead award
duplicate idempotence key with non-equivalent normalized input
unreconciled README and executable Runner-contract contradiction
attempt to write both repositories from one assignment
attempt to treat a logical recipe name as execution authority

downstream_gate.candidate_effect: none until the exact carrying candidate and cited decision/review evidence are verified under the repository DAG and integration rules
downstream_gate.activation_effect: none; downstream implementations must separately satisfy their assignments, scopes, validations, reviews, integration, and release gates

non_authority_notice: This approved baseline records a selected consumer contract. It does not assign work, activate an adapter or registry, authorize execution, accept or integrate work, publish, release, or close Feature 0045.
